name: Erie
seo_title: Erie Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Erie, CO: the Parade of Lights in historic downtown and Cocoa with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Station 15.
lede: Erie keeps Christmas in historic downtown, with a Chamber Parade of Lights, free carriage rides and Santa and Mrs. Claus on Briggs Street.
celebrates: The Erie Chamber of Commerce hosts the annual Parade of Lights through downtown Historic Erie, with school choirs, free carriage rides, open skating and a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus on Briggs Street before the parade. The Town of Erie adds a Cocoa with Santa and Mrs. Claus morning the next day. Families gather around Coal Creek Park and the historic town hall area, and local restaurants stay busy before the parade.
lastyear: In 2025 the Erie Parade of Lights was on Friday, December 5, with activities from 4 to 9 pm and the parade beginning at 6:30 pm in downtown Erie, according to a local restaurant's listing. Choirs, free carriage rides, Santa and Mrs. Claus and live performances were part of the evening, just as the Chamber lists them again for 2026.
facts: The Chamber's parade route travels north on Briggs Street from Maxwell Avenue to Cheesman Street, and local school choirs perform inside Orchard Community Church at 470 Briggs Street. Once the parade begins at 6:30 pm, vehicles cannot enter or leave the neighborhood east of Briggs Street. The Chamber asks visitors to park on residential streets, at the Erie Methodist Church or at Town Hall.
trains: Erie has no Christmas train of its own. The closest options are the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, which carries a Polar Express train ride, and the Georgetown Loop Railroad's Santa's Lighted Forest in the mountains. RTD's commuter rail serves nearby communities, so check the RTD trip planner for a car-free trip to Union Station and downtown Denver.

faq: When is the Erie Parade of Lights in 2026?

The Erie Chamber of Commerce lists the 2026 Parade of Lights for Friday, December 4, from 4:30 to 8:30 pm in downtown Historic Erie. The parade begins at 6:30 pm, and Santa and Mrs. Claus are on Briggs Street from 4:30 to 6 pm.
Is the Erie Parade of Lights free?

Public parades are free to watch, and the Chamber lists free carriage rides, school choirs and a visit with Santa before the parade. Open skating is also mentioned on the Chamber's page. Check the event card for the host's details.
Where do we park for the Erie parade?

The Chamber says parking is available along residential streets, at the Erie Methodist Church lot on Holbrook Street just west of Town Hall, and in the Town Hall lot at Holbrook and Cheesman. Do not block fire hydrants, and do not park in the alleys, which stay clear for first responders.
What is Cocoa with Santa and Mrs. Claus in Erie?
The Town of Erie's weekly update lists a Cocoa with Santa and Mrs. Claus event on Saturday, December 5, from 11 am to 1 pm at Station 15. It is carded on this page along with the parade.
sources: Nov. 23 Town of Erie Weekly Update
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Erie for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, 1 of them free. The Erie Chamber Parade of Lights is Friday, December 4, and Cocoa with Santa and Mrs. Claus follows on December 5. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Erie

  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus on Briggs Street before the parade, and Cocoa with Santa at Station 15
  • Season: December 4 and 5, 2026
